text:
alex: quick ping — CI failing on my PR (#1624). golangci-lint errors about arg names in runtime/kvcache.go after I renamed some identifiers.

alex: I changed `kv` -> `kvcache` in one place to be clearer but didn't update alias in imports; small fix but lint flags naming style. anyone have a preference for identifier style here? `kvCache` vs `kvcache` vs `KVCache`?

maria: in Go we usually use camelCase for vars -> `kvCache`. exported types/funcs should be `KVCache` (if you need export). keep it unexported unless needed :+1:

ben: agree with maria. also avoid underscores. if it's a package-level var maybe `defaultKVCache` etc.

ci-bot: golangci-lint failure — exportcheck: exported type `KVCache` without comment (runtime/kvcache.go:27)

sarah: if it's only used inside runtime, unexport it and add a short comment on the type. fewer public surface areas is better for rollouts.

alex: ok I'll unexport the type and add a comment. will push a tiny follow-up PR. ping me if that breaks any tests.

ben: timing wise, can we land this before the release branch cut tomorrow? it's small but touches runtime.

alex: will aim to push in 20m. if tests pass I'll request merge and add `@release-leads FYI` in the PR.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks. small lint-only changes are easiest to roll out.

alex: pushed (follow-up) — PR #1625. CI green locally, awaiting CI run. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1625

ci-bot: build passed — golangci-lint OK

alex: merged. :shipit:
